about.text: The Kurdish yogurt drink, also called ava mast: yogurt and salt mixed with water. Yogurt (mast) is the most widely eaten fermented dairy product among Kurds.

how.text: Mastaw (Kurdish mast 'yoghurt' + aw 'water') is yoghurt diluted with water and salted, the Kurdish counterpart of ayran.
